name: First Contact Resolution (FCR)
description: Measures the percentage of incoming customer interactions resolved on the initial contact without requiring transfers, escalations, or follow-up continuation sessions.
business_rules: An interaction achieves FCR when status is closed or resolved, with no outgoing CONTINUES relationship and no Transfer record.
Conversations with (:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->() indicate repeat contacts or unaddressed root causes.
Exclude interactions abandoned or disconnected before agent assignment.
search_text: First Contact Resolution (FCR) Measures the percentage of incoming customer interactions resolved on the initial contact without requiring transfers, escalations, or follow-up continuation sessions. fcr first call resolution resolved on first contact An interaction achieves FCR when status is closed or resolved, with no outgoing CONTINUES relationship and no Transfer record. Conversations with (:Conversation)-[:CONTINUES]->() indicate repeat contacts or unaddressed root causes. Exclude interactions abandoned or disconnected before agent assignment.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.status IN ["resolved", "closed"] OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTINUES]->(next:Conversation) WITH c, count(next) AS continuations RETURN count(c) AS total_resolved, sum(CASE WHEN continuations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fcr_count, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN continuations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(c), 1) AS fcr_rate_pct
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.status IN ["resolved", "closed"] OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONTINUES]->(next:Conversation) WITH c.channel AS dimension, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_total, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() AND next IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_fcr, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_total, sum(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() AND next IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_fcr RETURN dimension AS channel, curr_total, curr_fcr, CASE WHEN curr_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * curr_fcr / curr_total, 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS current_fcr_pct, prev_total, prev_fcr, CASE WHEN prev_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * prev_fcr / prev_total, 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS previous_fcr_pct, curr_total - prev_total AS volume_delta ORDER BY curr_total DESC

name: Average Handle Time (AHT)
description: Calculates the average duration from conversation start to end. Must ALWAYS be segmented by channel because synchronous channels differ drastically from asynchronous channels.
business_rules: Handle time duration is computed in seconds using duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds.
Always group by c.channel. Never pool asynchronous email (~1.5 hours) with live voice calls (~23 min) or webchat (~12 min).
Exclude records where ended_at is null.
search_text: Average Handle Time (AHT) Calculates the average duration from conversation start to end. Must ALWAYS be segmented by channel because synchronous channels differ drastically from asynchronous channels. aht handle time average duration call duration chat duration Handle time duration is computed in seconds using duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds. Always group by c.channel. Never pool asynchronous email (~1.5 hours) with live voice calls (~23 min) or webchat (~12 min). Exclude records where ended_at is null.
cypher_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at IS NOT NULL AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL RETURN c.channel AS channel, count(c) AS total_conversations, round(avg(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds), 1) AS avg_handle_time_sec, min(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds) AS min_sec, max(duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds) AS max_sec ORDER BY total_conversations DESC
diagnostic_template: MATCH (c:Conversation) WHERE c.created_at >= datetime() AND c.created_at < datetime() AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL WITH c.channel AS dimension, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at >= datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS curr_durs, [x IN collect(CASE WHEN c.created_at < datetime() THEN duration.between(c.created_at, c.ended_at).seconds ELSE NULL END) WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS prev_durs RETURN dimension AS channel, size(curr_durs) AS current_volume, CASE WHEN size(curr_durs) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, d IN curr_durs | s + d) / size(curr_durs), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS current_aht_sec, size(prev_durs) AS previous_volume, CASE WHEN size(prev_durs) > 0 THEN round(reduce(s = 0.0, d IN prev_durs | s + d) / size(prev_durs), 1) ELSE 0.0 END AS previous_aht_sec, size(curr_durs) - size(prev_durs) AS volume_delta ORDER BY current_volume DESC

name: Service Level (SLA Adherence)
description: Percentage of interactions answered or resolved within defined SLA target thresholds.
business_rules: Tracked on c.sla_status: within_sla, breached, not_started.
First response breach occurs when first_agent_response_at > first_response_due_at.
Resolution breach occurs when resolved_at > resolution_due_at.
